## Project summary
"ניחושי הפועל ירושלים" is a 2D prediction game for Hapoel Jerusalem basketball games, built with TypeScript, Vite, and Phaser 3. Users predict the 12-man squad, starting five, and a stat line (points/rebounds/steals/turnovers/blocks) for every selected squad player before each game. The UI is fully in Hebrew (RTL). See README.md for structure and roster/color sourcing notes.
